description: Langton's Ant on a 32 by 32 grid: each ant turns by the rule for the colour it stands on, repaints that cell and walks on, with its position and cell colour put out as voltages

params.text: Moves every ant on by the number of steps set by Steps
Lets the Gen input move the ants; while it is off only the Gen button does
Winds the grid and the ants back to the last saved state, and reads the Ants and Rule inputs again
Sets how many steps an ant takes on each clock, 1 to 32
Fills the grid with random colours
The share of the grid a random fill paints, 0 to 1
Multiplies the colour under the ant, counted as a fraction of the number of colours, before it reaches the output, 0 to 10
Saves the grid and the ant positions for a reset to come back to
The colour number an ant has to be standing on for its gate, 0 to 15

inputs.text: A rising edge moves the ants on while On is lit, one channel per ant
Sets the turn rule, one channel per colour: 0V turns the ant back, 1V turns it right, 2V sends it straight on and 3V turns it left; the number of channels sets how many colours the grid uses
A rising edge winds the grid and the ants back to the last saved state, and reads the Ants and Rule inputs again
Fills the grid with random colours while the voltage here is above 1V
Adds to the scale, one channel per ant, one for one in volts
Adds to the offset, one channel per ant, one for one in volts
A rising edge saves the grid and the ant positions for a reset to come back to
Places the ants, two channels per ant: the even channel is its column and the odd one its row, 3.2 cells per volt, and the signs of the pair set which way it faces

outputs.text: The column each ant stands on, one channel per ant, the 32 columns spread over 0-10V
The row each ant stands on, one channel per ant, the 32 rows spread over 0-10V
The colour under each ant as a fraction of the colour count, multiplied by the scale and shifted by the offset, one channel per ant
Carries 10V on an ant's channel while the colour under it is at or above the threshold, or the clock in its place when Output Clock is on

menu: Color Mode — draws the grid in Grey, Palette 1, Palette 2 or Palette 3
Clear — paints the whole grid back to colour zero
Default Rule — picks the turn rule used while the Rule input is unpatched: LR, LLRR, RLLR, RRLRR, LLRRRLRLRLLR, LLRRLLRRLLRRLLRRLLRR or RLLRRLLRRLLRRLLRRLLR
Num Ants — sets how many ants walk while the Ants input is unpatched, 1 to 8
Output Clock — sends the clock through the Gate output in place of a steady 10V

inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.6: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
